$comment: English catalogue. ca.json is the source of truth for the KEYS: this file must have
exactly the same set, and i18n-parity fails if it does not.
A key missing here is not a hole: t() falls back to Catalan, which is readable. A key
missing everywhere shows the key itself, which is a programming error and has to be
visible. The two are different failures and are kept different.
Conventions, same as ca.json: sentence case throughout, CAPITALS only in the small
eyebrows, the middle dot · as a separator, add buttons carry a literal +, placeholders
end in a single-character …, empty states are whole sentences, and NO EMOJI.
Quotation marks are the English ones (“ ”), not the guillemets used in ca and es.
